items.decision_note: The inventory is empty despite the job description containing potential character-sheet deliverables, but raw messages and source IDs are unavailable, so missing Requirements and the unresolved scope/completion evidence cannot be audited safely.

unresolved_candidate.description: The freelancer's statement that the budget covers only the character sheet may propose a scope limitation, but no unambiguous client acceptance of that limitation is present.
The broad completion claim refers to the work generally and does not independently identify which character-sheet outputs were completed.
